notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» is kept as a back_reference: prev1 opens with the same phrase (has_written_chain false) and prev2 writes its chain, but how much of prev2's chain this report takes over is not certain, so the phrase stands as written.
«عن أخيه معمر»: the brother is a kinship word with a name, so the name alone is the link (rule 7).
«عليهما السلام» is a blessing and is left out.

fixes.reason: THQ's English gives this report the chain of Hasan bin Yusuf, Uthman bin Jabala and Dharees, which is the chain of prev1, not the names written in this text

evidence.quote: وبهذا الاسناد، عن سلمة، عن عمر بن سعيد بن خثيم
With this chain of narrators, from Hasan bin Yusuf, from Uthman bin Jabala, from Dharees ibn Abdul-Malik,
